current_static.dispatch: Direct command -> sgenaxis_host helper -> FileSystemPort; no DispatchHost call in these handlers

planned_boundary.caller: Even current main/editor writer cannot authorize legacy typed/raw-root ingress; claimed writer/owner token cannot bypass
planned_boundary.state: Preserve owner document/revision/history/bindings/candidate/viewer registry/ephemeral selection and filesystem; no fallback/no OS open
planned_boundary.future_route: design_document_save -> M04_S2 persistence input; DependencyNotReady until wired
planned_boundary.future_owner: M04 document owner; M03 detached UI projections, no new command or port approved
